20.en: "When corruption takes hold of a limb, we amputate. Why should we treat the head differently?"

38.en: The Imperium has reached a level of stagnation that threatens its survival.

46.en: The Imperium must be audited throughout and rebuilt from the ground up.

54.en: Existing traditions and authority only serve to hold the Imperium back.

76.en: Investigate the ruling noble houses and factions of the Imperium for corruption, gross inequality, and ineffectuality — any given failure is heresy. Bring balance to bear by whatever means necessary; surgically remove corrupt members of noble houses or arm the downtrodden to incite revolution.

82.en: Recongregators ardently believe that the Imperium has become decadent and corrupt, and it is their duty to right this great wrong. They see evidence of this truth in every noble house and ruling council across the sector. Every growing slum, plague outbreak, and xenos incursion is proof of the ruling class’s inadequacy.

86.en: Macharian Recongregators believe the sector’s corruption stems from the time of the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.X5EFP7IgIUx6CaBW#the-macharian-heresy]{Macharian Heresy} when power was distributed to Lord Macharius’s generals following his death. Then, the power-grabbing and greed of those strong enough to seize power closed their eyes to the Emperor’s will. Now, their descendants exercise power and wealth they have no right to wield.

90.en: Some Recongregators work subtly, undermining the authority of those in power and replacing them with worthier candidates. Many rulers and noble houses have secrets that might be exposed to destroy their popularity, while some might fall victim to their own decadence or have unfortunate accidents. Other Macharian Recongregators use more destructive methods, such as arming a dissenting group, planting explosives on a day of mass worship, or sabotaging a planet’s economy and inciting chaos.

94.en: When Macharian Recongregators encounter other Inquisitors or work with other Imperial agents, they often conceal their true purpose. This is especially true when they encounter @UUID[.R7LueEsDUhrSYHNn]{Amalathians}, whose goals oppose the fundamentals of Recongregationism.

110.en: A Recongregator will keep their actual goals close to their chest, presenting solid excuses for their investigations — suspected heresy or xenos collusion within a noble house is a way in to shake the house down from top to bottom.

118.en: They are wary of leadership within the ruling factions and houses of the sector; though they recognise their authority, they do not necessarily respect it. They know these people are often the root of the Imperium’s internal problems.

126.en: They know the price of altering the structure of the Imperium will be terrible but ultimately necessary. Therefore, they are prepared to make extreme sacrifices to achieve their goals.

140.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.X5EFP7IgIUx6CaBW#the-defiant]{House Hysperion}, rulers of hive world Dominus Gamma, have reported Drukhari activity encroaching upon their planet from the nearby Osterum Shoals. Known as a defiant house by the Imperium, this is an opportunity to sway them and their assets to the Recongregators' cause. Aid them in their plight, embed Inquisition agents in their house, and garner favours for the future.

148.en: In gathering information about noble lineages in the sector, the Recongregator Patron has discovered inaccuracies in the archiviums of the cemetery world Eternan — bolstering the dead of one noble house and reducing the count from others. Travel to Eternan, cut deep into the local leadership, and punish those behind these inaccuracies. Replace the culprits with the Inquisition’s own agents.
